annotation.title_clean: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI: Ethically Aligned Design for Business
annotation.title_en: Prioritizing People and Planet as the Metrics for Responsible AI: Ethically Aligned Design for Business
annotation.authors_or_issuer: IEEE Standards Association (IEEE Global Initiative on Ethics of Autonomous and Intelligent Systems, Ethically Aligned Design for Business Committee)
annotation.summary_en: IEEE SA paper from the Ethically Aligned Design for Business Committee advising businesses to define responsible AI through expanded KPIs, namely human well-being (IEEE 7010) and ESG/UN SDG metrics. It sets out an Assess-Apply-Amplify framework and a readiness table. It is general AI guidance with no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Organizations should define 'responsible' at the outset and throughout the AIS life cycle using expanded KPIs.
Well-being, ESG and UN SDG metrics should complement financial indicators.
Uses IEEE Std 7010-2020 definition of well-being.
Assess-Apply-Amplify structure with a Well-Being Metrics Readiness Framework.
Cross-functional involvement (HR, legal, CSR, sustainability) in responsible AI metrics.
